attributes.action: Call for a government made from everyone from absolutely all parties
attributes.additional_details: UK governments formed by one main party often cause division and short-term policies. Forming a government from everyone from absolutely all political parties would combine the best ideas from every side for stronger solutions. This is vital for education reform — creating a fairer, practical system with full inclusion for young people with additional needs like autism, who struggle with timed written exams. Cross-party government would help achieve lasting change for every child.
attributes.background: We want the UK Government and Parliament to form a government made from everyone from absolutely all political parties. This combines the best ideas from every party to deliver fairer education and better support for young people with additional needs.

rejection.details:
Petitions need to call on the Government or Parliament to take a specific action. 
 
We're not sure exactly what you'd like the Government or Parliament to do. For instance, we're not sure how you would want a government from all parties to be structured, what representation would be given to each party, and whether this would apply only to parties who have won seats in the House of Commons at an election or other parties as well.
 
You could start a new petition explaining clearly what you would like the Government or Parliament to do.
